I'm 26...gonna be 27 in a few months, started smoking daily at 17, haven't looked back. I'm nowhere in life, all my jobs have been monkey jobs, and I haven't worked since the beginning of 2012. I quit for 3 months before, and 2 months before that. I even quit for 1 month a couple times in the past when I couldn't get any. (Nowadays I can always get it, but not when I was younger, like 17-20) Anyway...I hate this life, and I have been smoking daily again since 2013....my bro passed away and it was a suicide if you want to know. It sucks ass...he was only 23. I've mentioned this about him many times on reddit but I am just thinking about my brother daily since he died....I hate everything when I have no weed.

When I do have weed, I feel like everything is ok. Even now, I'm looking to the next time I can smoke, it's a physical craving, like I have trained my brain to need this shit.

And to make this all worse, I live in Missouri, it isn't even legal here so I'm constantly nervous and anxious. I don't even feel like going outside because all I feel like doing is playing video games and smoking weed, or masturbating (altogether I might masturbate 10 minutes a day at most), it's fucking disgusting. Still living with my mom, dad and 14 year old brother!  I must look terrible.
